description: This Java class implements a command strategy for handling 'DeleteFeatures' commands within the Ditto framework. It processes the command to delete features from a 'Thing' entity, producing appropriate event or error results, and manages entity tags for concurrency control.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturesStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractThingCommandStrategy for handling DeleteFeatures commands, encapsulating the logic of feature deletion from a Thing entity.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the delete features command, producing a result with either a FeaturesDeleted event or an error if features are not found.

methods.name: extractFeatures
methods.description: Extracts the Features from the given Thing, or throws an exception if not present.

methods.name: getEventToPersist
methods.description: Creates a FeaturesDeleted event to be persisted, with relevant context and metadata.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Constructs the response headers for the delete features command, including ETag if provided.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the EntityTag from the previous entity state for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty optional as no new EntityTag is generated after deletion.
